blocks.heading: Scope of the Formal Framework
blocks.text: This section establishes the formal architecture for the proposed AANEC-relaxed trapped-surface theorem. The framework is explicitly restricted to classical General Relativity with spherically symmetric collapse of massive stars and isotropic pressure. The central contribution is the separation of pointwise energy conditions from averaged focusing hypotheses, which are treated as independent geometric assumptions rather than consequences of matter dynamics alone. All formal objects defined here remain candidate formalizations or proposed obligations until human review resolves the missing mathematical specifications for the compactness parameter and the averaged null-convergence condition.

blocks.heading: Assumption Ledger
blocks.text: The following assumptions constitute the restricted model class for the proposed theorem. AANEC is treated as a matter-field condition, while averaged null-convergence is treated as a distinct geometric hypothesis required to ensure focusing along complete null generators.

blocks.heading: Core Geometric and Matter Definitions
blocks.text: The formal argument relies on the following symbol roles. Definitions for the Misner-Sharp compactness parameter and the explicit mathematical form of the averaged null-convergence condition remain unresolved and require human input to establish precise calculation thresholds and witness verification criteria.

blocks.heading: Interpretation of the Energy Integral
blocks.text: The relation above expresses the Averaged Null Energy Condition (AANEC) along a null geodesic generator $\gamma$ with tangent vector $k^a$ and affine parameter $\lambda$. This integral constraint on the stress-energy tensor $T_{ab}$ is proposed as the primary matter-field assumption. It is distinct from the pointwise Null Energy Condition and serves as the basis for the Raychaudhuri-type focusing arguments, though it does not by itself guarantee the explicit averaged null-convergence required for trapped-surface formation without additional geometric hypotheses.

blocks.heading: Proposed Trapped-Surface Threshold
blocks.text: In spherically symmetric stellar collapse satisfying AANEC, global hyperbolicity, regular matter fields, complete null generators, and an explicit averaged null-convergence condition, reaching a model-dependent compactness threshold forces trapped-surface formation. This proposition remains unverified and is contingent upon the resolution of the mathematical form of the averaged focusing assumption and the precise definition of the compactness parameter.

blocks.heading: Failure Condition and Remnant Exclusion
blocks.text: The validity of the proposed threshold fails if the explicit averaged null-convergence condition is not satisfied along complete generators, if null generators are incomplete, or if quantum stress-energy effects violate the averaged assumptions. Consequently, the exclusion of stable non-black-hole remnants above a compactness-dependent mass scale is conditional on these geometric premises holding within the restricted model class.

blocks.heading: Unresolved Proof Obligations
blocks.text: Three proof obligations remain unresolved and require human input to close the derivation. The mathematical form of the averaged null-convergence condition must be specified to verify candidate witnesses. The Misner-Sharp compactness parameter requires a precise definition involving effective mass within radius to establish the exclusion bound. Finally, the formal claim and proof obligation templates require canonical status confirmation to proceed with rigorous derivation.
